Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleMode.zh: 绘制模式 / 穿透模式

Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleModeDescriptio.zh: 绘制时接管输入，穿透时操作桌面。
Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleModeDescriptio.en: Draw to edit; pass through to use your desktop.

Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleVisibility.zh: 隐藏画布 / 显示画布

Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleVisibilityDesc.zh: 显隐不清空内容，也不改变当前模式。
Acceptance2.Welcome.ToggleVisibilityDesc.en: Keep your content and current mode when hiding or showing.

Acceptance2.Welcome.Description.zh: 启动时是一张空白画布。需要继续上次的内容时，可从菜单打开历史画布或工程。
Acceptance2.Welcome.Description.en: Each launch starts with a blank canvas. Open canvas history or a saved project from the menu to continue earlier work.
